Package com.csse3200.game.components.boss

Class FinalBossSummonMovementComponent

java.lang.Object
com.csse3200.game.components.Component
com.csse3200.game.components.boss.FinalBossSummonMovementComponent
public class FinalBossSummonMovementComponent extends Component
Scatters summons, then continuously approaches the player from assigned directions.

Each summon retains its angular position around the player. There is no timed fallback to chasing the player's centre.
